database: Original NHL DuckDB archive (upstream source; compact input snapshots are bundled)

queries.nhl_seasons.csv: SELECT CAST(playerId AS VARCHAR) player_id, season, name, team, position, games_played games, icetime/60.0 AS minutes, I_F_shotAttempts attempts,I_F_goals goals,I_F_oZoneShiftStarts oz_starts,I_F_dZoneShiftStarts dz_starts FROM mp_skaters_seasons WHERE situation='5on5' AND season BETWEEN 2018 AND 2025 ORDER BY season,playerId
queries.nhl_birth_dates.csv: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(playerId AS VARCHAR) player_id,birthDate FROM nhl_stats_skater_bios ORDER BY player_id
queries.nhl_2024_player_games.csv: SELECT CAST(playerId AS BIGINT) player_id,name,nhl_game_id game_id,gameDate,playerTeam team,position,icetime/60.0 AS minutes,I_F_shotAttempts attempts,I_F_goals goals FROM mp_skaters_games WHERE season=2024 AND situation='5on5' ORDER BY nhl_game_id,playerId

all_situations_source: Aggregated original MoneyPuck player-game counts into player-season halves; see README.md in this directory for coverage and source caveats.
